extracted.name: Quick Mango Salsa
extracted.description: This fruity salsa is great with pita chips. You could use it to top salmon or your favorite grilled fish, steak, or pork chop. You can add pineapple for even more of a tropical flair. The possibilities for this recipe are endless!
ingredient_lines: 1 small jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Stir mango, tomato, onion, jalapeño pepper, cilantro, and lime juice together in a bowl until well combined; season with salt and pepper.
